title: Beetroot and Feta Salad
summary: A deceptively easy, YET extremely sophisticated salad recipe...
extendedSummary: A deceptively easy, YET extremely sophisticated salad recipe which I first tried in Adelaide over Christmas in 2024. I love how little ingredients are in this, but how it all comes together in a very nice pairing way.
method: Quarter the baby beetroots and add to a bowl, with cubed feta
To make the lemon vinaigrette: combine parsley, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper in a small dish and mix thoroughly
Pour lemon vinaigrette over beetroots and feta - toss and serve
